recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Rumors of a March 22 heart ritual", "body": "Chance noted that Skull and Bones used the number 322, his birthday, and Mark Steeves said he gave a tour in New Haven on that date. Mark relayed a rumor from his friend that members ate a piece of a heart at sunrise atop the tallest building, and he stressed that it was only rumor and unconfirmed in the books he had read. Chance tied the idea to organs having their own character, drawing on his work with energy fields, and another panelist linked the date to Aries season and sacrificial symbolism."}, {"title": "Puritan alchemy and the roots of Yale", "body": "Mark argued that Yale and Harvard began as schools for ministers, in a world where alchemy, divination and mineral medicine could sit comfortably beside Christianity. He pointed to John Winthrop the Younger as an alchemist governor and suggested the pharmaceutical era grew from that quick cure mindset. A panelist added that gatekeeping healing resembled gatekeeping spiritual life. Mark also described Native American missions and the William Morgan affair as the backdrop for the rise of secret societies."}, {"title": "New Haven's grid, green and pentagram paths", "body": "Mark showed slides arguing that New Haven's nine square plan, its three churches facing east and the paths across the green formed deliberate symbols. He described two pentagram shapes beside an eight sided fountain and a mass grave beneath the lawn. Panelists suggested that one star resembled a broken pentagram or a universal hexagram from the Thoth deck, and one read the Hebrew letters for the town initials as Nebo. Mark also proposed that the nine square grid worked as a Saturn magic square."}, {"title": "Death, rebirth and the skull symbol", "body": "Mark described the cemetery gateway as Egyptian in design, linked it to Hermopolis and the ancient eight, and said the founders of Skull and Bones spent a summer in Germany with Hegel. He argued that Hegelian death and rebirth shaped the order's coffin initiation. Mario said the sphinx, the tower and the obelisk carried funerary meaning, and that occult groups encoded how to die in their art. A panelist wondered if the skull and crossbones reflected a prima materia of destruction and regeneration."}, {"title": "Tongues, language and the word for skull", "body": "Chance connected the Hebrew word for skull to the word for birth and to crowning, then asked whether ritual body part consumption echoed a second birth. The conversation moved to Shiva lingam and lingua, then a chat viewer's mention of the Kechari mudra led the panel into the tongue frenulum and its penile counterpart. Mario tied the hermit card and veil symbolism to Virgo, and Gabe tied Arcturus to the lunar calendar."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Mark Steeves of My Family Thinks I'm Crazy returns to Vibe Rant to talk about his research into the Yale no-so-secret-anymore society known as Skull & Bones. Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies will also be joining us tonight, to add his illuminati symbolism studies to the analysis.
